goal: Implement the host delivery adapter without unsafe foreground-window fallbacks.
acceptance: No timer is the normal continuation engine.
No fallback may send to a frontmost or merely visible window.
Delivery accepts only a durable, idempotent original-action packet for an exact target.
Missing target identity, permission, active work signal, or authorization must fail closed.
No real desktop interaction is claimed verified until the UI-safety lock is explicitly lifted.
done_definition: SUBMITTED only; verifier confirms all fail-closed paths.
